Initialize with `git clone` + `git submodule update --init --recursive`; copy `.vscode/settings.json.template` and `.vscode/sftp.json.template` to generate per-environment configs before any IRIS or SFTP operation. Frontend deployment uses `node scripts/sftp-sync.js upload <path>` (auto-matches sftp.json channel by path); backend compilation uses MCP commands `iris_doc_load` (with wildcarded package-root paths like `D*oc`) and `iris_doc_compile(doc="/imedical/web/csp/xxx.csp")`. Multi-repo Git ops run from the repo root via `node scripts/git-batch-*.js` (pull, branch, stash, mr, logs).
